A photo list of exactly what is included (torque converter? harness? sensors? solenoids? transfer case? cooler lines?).
Video showing the gearbox tested/engaging gears (or installed test) and a leak check.
Photos of connector ports and any loose wiring/hoses showing they are complete and not cut/damaged.
response.reason: The photos show a used gearbox assembly, but there is no readable identification and the seller’s specific claims (Ford Expedition V8 4WD fitment and Belgium origin) are not verifiable remotely.
